groups.checked-line-and-inn-arithmetic: u32*u32 fits u64 exactly; widening before checked_mul preserves it. Total addition rejects overflow explicitly. Inn ceil-day computation divides before adding partial-day1 and multiplying fixed2, so u64 minute input stays far below u64 range with actual calendar day1440; Option failure policy remains legitimate. Constants and fixed11 ingredient lookup have no index or overflow risk.
groups.sufficiency-saturation-is-correct: split_party_purchase_payment only compares saturating sum to representable amount. If true sum overflows u64, cappedMAX still exceeds every possible u64 request, so predicate is unchanged. pooled=min(amount,party) makes amount-pooled safe and remaining payment is within personal funds. Do not replace this with checked_add rejection that would refuse affordable purchases solely because combined balances exceed representation.
groups.pricing-and-fraction-policies: F034 quote cap remains before checked totals. u32-to-f32 pricing also loses exact large integer precision; current f32 rounding sequence is explicit existing policy, so do not silently change it while fixing overflow. Shared-language finite clamp/nonfinite0 is current boundary policy, not universal permission for NaN retained application state. Whole-item sell minimum1 differs from fractional food sale floor permitting0; both must survive migration.
groups.vocabulary-native-port: Closed unit enums and stable_id exhaustive match have no arithmetic, indexing or mutation. Serde/optional SpacetimeType are actual native format/storage encoders; lifecycle variants alone do not prove corresponding payload/state coherence. Preserve canonical Core owners and stable token spelling rather than reintroduce DB string mirrors. P16/PR same imported/native contexts compared; no generated SDK or whole parsed state clearance.
groups.existing-source-tests: Existing economy tests use fixed small100, balances8/20/15, checkedu32MAX line and totalMAX+1, fractional3/.75 andNaN inputs; source-read only. No tests, cases, assertions or helpers added or executed.

findings.case: merchant_buy_price(u32MAX) computes a finite f32 quote above u32MAX, then native asu32 silently caps it. checked_merchant_line_total(quote,1) later succeeds in u64 but cannot recover the capped quote. merchant_sell_food_lot_value(f32MAX) likewise passes finite/nonnegative gates, computes a value above u64 range and returnsSome(u64MAX) from a saturating cast. Source-only representable API cases; no ordinary authored price/food lot or executed trade claimed.
findings.operation: Leaf finite/nonnegative admission and checked line extensions do not establish representable unit/lot quotes. The information is lost at the earlier native integer conversion.
findings.connected_repair: Carry canonical quoted currency values and explicit checked quote conversion through pricing and totals. Return a concrete overflow cause before successful publication, or use the chosen canonical wider representation while preserving intended pricing/rounding policy. Do not silently saturate a semantic payable amount or assume all finite food-lot values fit integer coin. Preserve zero-value remainder sales and explicit whole-item minimum1 policy; no unsolicited exchange-rate feature.
findings.acceptance: Every successful quote fits its retained currency representation before line multiplication/addition; a later checked total cannot legitimize an earlier capped value. Existing fixtures only, no new tests/assertions/helpers.
findings.deduplication: Strategic merchant quote conversion graph, distinct from valid saturating sufficiency comparison and nested score clamp.
